questions.hintZh: 先代入原點，再判斷解集位於邊界直線的哪一側。
questions.solution:
The boundary is \(4x+5y+20=0\), with intercepts \((-5,0)\) and \((0,-4)\). At the origin, \(4(0)+5(0)+20=20>0\), so the origin is not in the solution set. The required half-plane is the side opposite the origin, and the boundary is included. This is graph B.

\[\boxed{\text{B}}\]

questions.stem:
In the figure, the shaded region is bounded by \(x=k\), \(x+y=k\) and \(2x-y=-h\), where \(h\) and \(k\) are positive. If \((2,6)\) lies in the shaded region, including its boundary, which of the following value pairs \((h,k)\) are possible?

II. \(h=2,k=9\)
III. \(h=3,k=8\)

questions.hint: Translate the shaded triangle into inequalities before testing the point.
questions.hintZh: 先把陰影三角形寫成不等式，再逐組代入該點。
questions.solution:
From the figure, points in the region satisfy \(x\leq k\), \(y\leq 2x+h\) and \(y\geq k-x\). At \((2,6)\), these require \(2\leq k\), \(6\leq 4+h\), and \(6\geq k-2\).
I: \(h=2,k=6\) satisfies all three. II: \(h=2,k=9\) fails \(6\geq 7\). III: \(h=3,k=8\) satisfies all three. Hence I and III only.
\[\boxed{\text{C}}\]
questions.solutionZh:
按圖中陰影位置，區域內的點須符合 \(x\leq k\)、\(y\leq 2x+h\) 及 \(y\geq k-x\)。代入 \((2,6)\)，條件為 \(2\leq k\)、\(6\leq 4+h\) 及 \(6\geq k-2\)。
I：\(h=2,k=6\) 三項均成立。II：\(h=2,k=9\) 不符合 \(6\geq 7\)。III：\(h=3,k=8\) 三項均成立。因此只有 I 和 III。
\[\boxed{\text{C}}\]

questions.hintZh: 先找出可能的整數 x，再逐個 x 計算整數 y 的個數。
questions.solution:
Since \(x>-2\) and \(x\) is an integer, \(x\geq-1\). Combining the two sloping bounds shows \(x\leq3\), so test \(x=-1,0,1,2,3\).
The integer y-ranges are respectively \([-1,6]\), \([-1,5]\), \([0,3]\), \([1,2]\), and \([1,1]\). Their counts are \(8,7,4,2,1\), giving \(8+7+4+2+1=22\).

questions.stem: Consider \(x\geq2\), \(y\geq1\), \(3x+2y\leq23\) and \(3y-x\leq7\). If \((x,y)\) lies in the feasible region, what is the difference between the greatest and least values of \(x+2y-k\), where \(k\) is a constant?
questions.stemZh: 考慮限制 \(x\geq2\)、\(y\geq1\)、\(3x+2y\leq23\) 及 \(3y-x\leq7\)。若 \((x,y)\) 位於可行區域，\(x+2y-k\) 的最大值與最小值之差是多少？其中 \(k\) 為常數。
questions.hint: The constant k shifts both extreme values equally, so it cancels in their difference.
questions.hintZh: 常數 k 會令最大值和最小值同時平移，因此在兩者之差中抵消。
questions.solution:
The feasible vertices are \((2,1)\), \((2,3)\), \((5,4)\) and \((7,1)\). The corresponding values of \(x+2y\) are 4, 8, 13 and 9. Subtracting the least from the greatest gives \(13-4=9\); the \(-k\) term cancels.
\[\boxed{\text{C}}\]

questions.stem:
Solve the following systems of inequalities graphically.
(a) \(3x-2y-12\geq0\), \(2x+y<6\).
(b) \(3x+2y\leq10\), \(4y-x<8\), \(-5>x-y\).
questions.hint: Rewrite each boundary as y=mx+c, mark strict boundaries dashed, and shade the common half-plane.
questions.hintZh: 把各邊界改寫成 y=mx+c；嚴格不等式用虛線，並找出共同半平面。
questions.answer: (a) The common region is below both lines y=(3x−12)/2 and y=6−2x; their intersection is (24/7,−6/7). The first boundary is included and the second is excluded. (b) The common region is x<−4 and x+5<y<x/4+2; the two sloping boundaries are excluded. The inequality 3x+2y≤10 is redundant in this region.
questions.answerZh: (a) 共同解集位於直線 y=(3x−12)/2 及 y=6−2x 的下方；兩線交點為 (24/7,−6/7)。第一條邊界包括在解集中，第二條不包括。(b) 共同解集為 x<−4 且 x+5<y<x/4+2；兩條斜邊界均不包括。在此區域內 3x+2y≤10 是冗餘限制。
questions.solution:
(a) Rewrite the inequalities as \(y\leq(3x-12)/2\) and \(y<6-2x\). Their boundary lines meet when \(3x/2-6=6-2x\), giving \(x=24/7\), \(y=-6/7\). Shade below both; use a solid line for the first boundary and a dashed line for the second.
(b) The last two inequalities give \(y<x/4+2\) and \(y>x+5\), which can overlap only when \(x<-4\). Thus \(x+5<y<x/4+2\). In this region, \(3x+2y<3x+x/2+4< -10\), so \(3x+2y\leq10\) is automatically satisfied. The boundary point \((-4,1)\) is excluded.

questions.stem:
(a) If \(x,y\) are integers, solve graphically \(2x+3y\leq6\), \(x-y\geq-2\), \(x-4y\leq4\) and \(y\geq0\).
(b) Find the maximum and minimum of \(P=x-2y\) over these integer solutions.
(c) If \(y\geq0\) is removed, do the maximum and minimum remain unchanged? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
(a) 若 x、y 均為整數，以圖解法求解 \(2x+3y\leq6\)、\(x-y\geq-2\)、\(x-4y\leq4\) 及 \(y\geq0\)。
(b) 求這些整數解中 \(P=x-2y\) 的最大值和最小值。
(c) 若刪去 \(y\geq0\)，最大值和最小值會否改變？解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: List integer lattice points row by row; for part (c), find the new lower boundary created by the remaining inequalities.
questions.hintZh: 逐行列出整數格點；(c) 須由其餘限制找出新的下界。
questions.answerZh: (a) 共有 10 個整數解。(b) 最大值 3；最小值 −4。(c) 不變。
questions.solution:
(a) The feasible polygon has vertices \((-2,0)\), \((0,2)\) and \((3,0)\); \(x-4y\leq4\) does not cut this region. The integer points by rows are: y=0, x=−2 to 3; y=1, x=−1 to 1; y=2, x=0. There are 6+3+1=10 points.
(b) At these points, \(P=x-2y\) has maximum 3 at \((3,0)\) and minimum −4 at \((0,2)\).
(c) Without \(y\geq0\), the remaining constraints imply \(-2\leq y\leq2\). New integer rows are y=−2, x=−4; and y=−1, x=−3,−2,−1,0. Their objective values are 0 and −1,0,1,2, respectively. None exceeds 3 or is below −4, so both extrema remain unchanged. The continuous polygon has a fractional vertex \((36/11,-2/11)\), which is not an integer feasible point.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 可行多邊形頂點為 \((-2,0)\)、\((0,2)\) 及 \((3,0)\)；\(x-4y\leq4\) 不會再截走此區域。逐行整數點為：y=0 時 x=−2 至 3；y=1 時 x=−1 至 1；y=2 時 x=0。總數為 6+3+1=10。(b) 這些點的 \(P=x-2y\) 最大值為 3（在 \((3,0)\)），最小值為 −4（在 \((0,2)\)）。(c) 刪去 \(y\geq0\) 後，其餘限制給出 \(-2\leq y\leq2\)。新增整數行為 y=−2 時 x=−4；以及 y=−1 時 x=−3、−2、−1、0。相應目標值分別為 0 及 −1、0、1、2，均不超過 3 或小於 −4，所以兩個極值不變。連續多邊形的分數頂點 \((36/11,-2/11)\) 不是整數可行點。

en.text: (a) If \(x,y\) are integers, solve graphically \(2x+3y\leq6\), \(x-y\geq-2\), \(x-4y\leq4\) and \(y\geq0\).
(b) Find the maximum and minimum of \(P=x-2y\) over these integer solutions.
(c) If \(y\geq0\) is removed, do the maximum and minimum remain unchanged? Explain.

zh-Hant.text: (a) 若 x、y 均為整數，以圖解法求解 \(2x+3y\leq6\)、\(x-y\geq-2\)、\(x-4y\leq4\) 及 \(y\geq0\)。
(b) 求這些整數解中 \(P=x-2y\) 的最大值和最小值。
(c) 若刪去 \(y\geq0\)，最大值和最小值會否改變？解釋你的答案。

en.text: (a) The feasible polygon has vertices \((-2,0)\), \((0,2)\) and \((3,0)\); \(x-4y\leq4\) does not cut this region. The integer points by rows are: y=0, x=−2 to 3; y=1, x=−1 to 1; y=2, x=0. There are 6+3+1=10 points.
(b) At these points, \(P=x-2y\) has maximum 3 at \((3,0)\) and minimum −4 at \((0,2)\).

(c) Without \(y\geq0\), the remaining constraints imply \(-2\leq y\leq2\). New integer rows are y=−2, x=−4; and y=−1, x=−3,−2,−1,0. Their objective values are 0 and −1,0,1,2, respectively. None exceeds 3 or is below −4, so both extrema remain unchanged. The continuous polygon has a fractional vertex \((36/11,-2/11)\), which is not an integer feasible point.

zh-Hant.text: (c) 刪去 \(y\geq0\) 後，其餘限制給出 \(-2\leq y\leq2\)。新增整數行為 y=−2 時 x=−4；以及 y=−1 時 x=−3、−2、−1、0。相應目標值分別為 0 及 −1、0、1、2，均不超過 3 或小於 −4，所以兩個極值不變。連續多邊形的分數頂點 \((36/11,-2/11)\) 不是整數可行點。
